correctness.rationale: The energy difference on flipping site i is 2J sigma_i(sigma_{i-1}+sigma_{i+1}-kappa(sigma_{i-2}+sigma_{i+2})). This five-spin condition gives an exact 16-state quadruple de Bruijn transfer-matrix trace for all n>=5; only threshold kappa=1 can change allowed transitions. Independently constructed all 3 integer 16x16 matrices and used exact SymPy determinants to reproduce source characteristic factorization in each phase. Brute full spin enumeration for each n=5..9 matched trace(T^n) in all 15 cases. Verified exact Collatz–Wielandt component inequalities for both 14-state Perron vectors: the critical lambda lies in (1.665,1.668) and high lambda in (1.554,1.557), separated from phi in (1.618,1.619). The source checks strongly connected primitive components; Perron–Frobenius then yields the exponential limit, not just finite trace data. At kappa=1 neutral flips satisfy >=0, and the statement does not equate weak minima with dynamically absorbing states.
